messages.author: 3d9ae76d08a196e1
messages.subject: Stuck with dependency problem
parts:
Hi all,

So I copied my R project from my PC at work to a USB drive so I could code on at home. But when loading libraries I get:

"Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
  unable to load shared object '/media/SamsungBoot/R_project/packrat/lib/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/3.1.1/Rcpp/libs/Rcpp.so':
  /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.20' not found (required by /media/SamsungBoot/R_project/packrat/lib/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/3.1.1/Rcpp/libs/Rcpp.so)
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘plyr’"

So as far as I understand, there is some gcc library I am missing on the system. After some package installations I have:

ii  gcc                                   4:4.8.1-2ubuntu3                                  amd64        GNU C compiler
ii  gcc-4.8                               4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                   amd64        GNU C compiler
ii  gcc-4.8-base:amd64                    4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                   amd64        GCC, the GNU Compiler Collection (base package)
ii  gcc-4.8-base:i386                     4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                   i386         GCC, the GNU Compiler Collection (base package)
ii  gcc-4.8-plugin-dev                    4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                   amd64        Files for GNU GCC plugin development.
ii  lib32gcc-4.8-dev                      4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                   amd64        GCC support library (32 bit development files)
ii  lib32gcc1                             1:4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                 amd64        GCC support library (32 bit Version)
ii  libgcc-4.8-dev:amd64                  4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                   amd64        GCC support library (development files)
ii  libgcc1:amd64                         1:4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                 amd64        GCC support library
ii  libgcc1:i386                          1:4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                 i386         GCC support library
ii  libx32gcc1                            1:4.8.1-10ubuntu9                                 amd64        GCC support library (x32)

But it still doesn't work.Can anyone help me, what do I need to install? I'm running Linux Mint 16.

Thanks a lot,

Florian

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Stuck with dependency problem
parts:
Hi Haribald,

It sounds like you've copied everything, including the private library -- you will need to rebuild this library from source if you move your project to a new machine. Please try cleaning out your packrat library and doing a `packrat::restore`:

    unlink(packrat::packrat_lib(), recursive = TRUE)
    packrat::restore()

Thanks,
Kevin
